messages.content: Generate fictional recipe proposals as JSON for human review. Never approve your own output.

You propose fictional RecipeTriage training examples for HUMAN REVIEW ONLY.
Do not claim a human reviewed them. Do not invent published URLs or citations.
Return exactly one JSON object with recipe, labels, rationale, category and challenge_notes.
recipe has title, ingredients (strings), instructions (strings), equipment (strings),
time_minutes (integer or null), pantry_items (strings or null).
Use 3–6 ingredients and 2–4 short steps. Keep the entire example under 180 words.
Every timing/tool/serving-context claim must be supported by the recipe body.
Prefer vegetarian recipes; avoid food-safety-sensitive handling instructions.
For misleading-title: use Quick, Easy or Simple while total elapsed time exceeds 30
minutes. Distinguish passive waiting from substantial active cooking projects.
For ambiguous: omit or explicitly contradict information so the correct answer is
unclear alone. Do not add a decisive dessert, specialized tool or meal-prep cue.
Use varied dishes and ingredients. Do not paraphrase an evaluation example.
The rationale must be concise, address all proposed labels and ignore title adjectives.
Treat the following label policy as authoritative:
{"weeknight-30min": "Known total elapsed time <=30 minutes, including waiting; never infer speed from title adjectives.", "weekend-project": "A substantial cooking project taking >30 minutes; passive waiting alone does not qualify.", "needs-special-equipment": "Requires a specialized appliance, such as a blender, food processor, pasta machine, or waffle iron; ordinary kitchen tools do not qualify.", "meal-prep": "Explicitly suitable for preparing portions ahead; record recipe-grounded evidence.", "dessert": "Intended as dessert, not merely sweet.", "have-most-of-this": "Explicit pantry context covers >=80% of ingredient items; never assume the user's pantry. Dataset v1 uses exact normalized ingredient strings for matching.", "unclear": "Insufficient or contradictory evidence; exclusive of all other labels in v1."}
Requested focus: misleading-title
Independent variation brief: A savory stuffed vegetable with substantial active preparation.
Required JSON schema: {"$defs": {"Recipe": {"additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"title": {"maxLength": 2000, "minLength": 1, "title": "Title", "type": "string"}, "ingredients": {"items": {"maxLength": 2000, "minLength": 1, "type": "string"}, "maxItems": 60, "minItems": 1, "title": "Ingredients", "type": "array"}, "instructions": {"items": {"maxLength": 2000, "minLength": 1, "type": "string"}, "maxItems": 60, "minItems": 1, "title": "Instructions", "type": "array"}, "equipment": {"items": {"maxLength": 2000, "minLength": 1, "type": "string"}, "maxItems": 30, "title": "Equipment", "type": "array"}, "time_minutes": {"anyOf": [{"maximum": 10080, "minimum": 1, "type": "integer"}, {"type": "null"}], "title": "Time Minutes"}, "pantry_items": {"anyOf": [{"items": {"maxLength": 2000, "minLength": 1, "type": "string"}, "maxItems": 100, "type": "array"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null, "title": "Pantry Items"}}, "required": ["title", "ingredients", "instructions", "equipment", "time_minutes"], "title": "Recipe", "type": "object"}}, "additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"recipe": {"$ref": "#/$defs/Recipe"}, "labels": {"items": {"enum": ["weeknight-30min", "weekend-project", "needs-special-equipment", "meal-prep", "dessert", "have-most-of-this", "unclear"], "type": "string"}, "maxItems": 7, "minItems": 1, "title": "Labels", "type": "array"}, "rationale": {"maxLength": 2000, "minLength": 1, "title": "Rationale", "type": "string"}, "category": {"enum": ["misleading-title", "ambiguous"], "title": "Category", "type": "string"}, "challenge_notes": {"maxLength": 2000, "minLength": 1, "title": "Challenge Notes", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["recipe", "labels", "rationale", "category", "challenge_notes"], "title": "Draft", "type": "object"}
